# ARM Agency

ARM Agency helps accountable teams design, deploy, and govern autonomous AI workflows, agent infrastructure, and generative-engine visibility programs.

## Primary offerings

- AI Infrastructure Audit: a bounded assessment of AI infrastructure readiness, operational gaps, and deployment priorities.
- Mandate Chain Design Workshop: a facilitated working session for decision rights, operating constraints, and implementation scope.
- Custom MCP Tool: a scoped tool-development engagement for a defined workflow or integration need.
- GEO Retainers: ongoing generative-engine optimization, entity architecture, structured-data maintenance, and content operations.
- ARM Mandate Services: governed AI workflow and agent-infrastructure engagements for qualified organizations.

## Agentic commerce resources

This `.xyz` property is the independent legacy/operating branch of ARM Agency. The current `.com` property owns the strategic x402/AiFi pillar at https://www.arm-agency.com/resources/agentic-commerce-x402-aifi/. These `.xyz` guides provide deeper implementation and readiness treatment; they are not mirrors or cross-domain canonicals.

- Agentic commerce infrastructure: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/agentic-commerce-infrastructure
- x402 agent payments: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/x402-agent-payments
- AiFi governance controls: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/aifi-governance-controls
- Agent payment readiness: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/agent-payment-readiness — scored five-dimension stop, sandbox, or bounded-pilot instrument

ARM Agency uses AiFi as a category label for governed AI-native financial operations, not as a claim of affiliation with any AiFi-branded company or institute. x402 protocol support does not by itself establish budget authority, compliance, safe fulfillment, or operational readiness.

- Browse public offerings: https://arm-agency.xyz/#pricing
- Request a qualified conversation: https://arm-agency.xyz/#contact
- Existing customers use the authenticated client portal at /portal.

## AI Discovery Operating System

ARM Agency publishes an interlinked public decision library about controllable AI-discovery foundations. It distinguishes technical SEO, structured-data governance, evidence-led content, visual discovery, and qualified GEO readiness from claims about third-party search or model outcomes.

- Hub: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/ai-discovery-readiness
- AI discovery measurement: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/ai-discovery-measurement
- AI Mastery foundations: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/ai-mastery-foundations

- Technical SEO for AI discovery: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/technical-seo-ai-discovery
- Structured data governance: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/structured-data-governance
- Evidence-led content architecture: https://arm-agency.xyz/insights/evidence-led-content-architecture

## Data and trust

ARM Agency publishes only service descriptions and operating details it can support. Customer, revenue, uptime, deployment, and outcome claims are not assumed without documented evidence.
